updates.content:
full disclosure: i'm igor, i build sapling. here's why i hold $SAPLING.

the mission
become the first fully zcash-native launchpad on solana, and the first to bring its coins onto zcash itself the day zcash shielded assets (ZSAs) go live on mainnet.

the thesis
zcash doesn't need to become a memecoin chain. it needs a road from where the traders already are. sapling points solana's biggest on-ramp at $ZEC:
- today: every coin is paired with ZEC and grows its own ZEC roots
- next: shielded end to end. connect a zcash wallet, plant, trade and cash out without leaving the shielded pool
- then: when ZSAs land, sapling coins become native zcash assets. we already built it on the ZSA testnet: saplingcash/zsa is open source

where $SAPLING fits
$SAPLING is the rootstock. 0.50% of every trade on the platform buys $SAPLING and burns it, forever. the treasury buys and burns on top. more activity on sapling = more $SAPLING gone.

the numbers since launch
- 1,249 ZEC traded
- 21,509 trades from 4,243 traders
- 45 coins planted
- 18.2% of $SAPLING supply burned

what's already live
- every coin has ZEC roots you can harvest
- holder rewards paid in ZEC
- native ZEC in and out
- shielded stamps on zcash mainnet
- open source: zcash-delivery-proof, stamps, zakura-bench, zsa
- the vault's upgrades need a 2-of-3 multisig

i buy $SAPLING publicly and hold it with all of you: we're aligned, and my own skin is in the game. i'm not selling anytime soon, no matter how high or low we go. i'm here for the long run.

not financial advice. do your own research.

comment.comment:
Crypto Investors Outraged After Startup Makes Tokenized Stocks Understandable Without Requiring 17 Browser Tabs

ROBINHOOD CHAIN — Cryptocurrency investors expressed widespread alarm after discovering that Prism Assets ($PRISM) is building an actual platform for finding, analyzing, and trading tokenized real-world assets.

“This is incredibly irresponsible,” explained one investor. “I’ve spent years learning how to navigate six block explorers, three decentralized exchanges, and a Telegram group run by someone named LiquidityWizard69. Now these people want everything in one place?”

Prism offers wallet-based trading, asset indexes, liquidity analysis, reserve verification, and curated investment baskets, threatening the industry’s longstanding commitment to making simple financial transactions unnecessarily complicated.

Even more disturbing, the protocol offers PRISM staking, allowing holders to earn additional tokens after a 72-hour warm-up.

“First they give us a trading terminal, then on-chain verification, and now staking rewards,” warned one analyst. “At this rate, investors might start asking where those rewards actually come from.”

Industry experts are particularly concerned that Prism could become a convenient gateway to tokenized equities, potentially allowing ordinary investors to participate in financial markets without first developing a crippling addiction to blockchain explorers.

With PRISM recently trading around a $1.2 million valuation, analysts warn that widespread adoption could lead to the deeply unsettling prospect of investors evaluating actual usage instead of motivational posts.

Developers have reportedly been urged to discontinue the trading terminal immediately and replace it with an AI agent that predicts Bitcoin prices using astrology.

At press time, investors were demanding that Prism stop building infrastructure and announce a revolutionary new roadmap featuring the words institutional, quantum, and decentralized at least 40 times.
